note: Micon submodule: one field widget `micon_linkit` (label 'Linkit (with icon)') for the core `link` field type, extending Linkit's LinkitWidget + micon_link's MiconLinkWidgetTrait. Requires contrib linkit and micon_link. Icon stored on the link value at options.attributes.data-icon; same widget settings as micon_link. No formatter, no settings form/route. Medium reads back a link field's widget id; hard switches a link field's form-display widget to micon_linkit. Grounded in the core.entity_form_display component type.

evals.prompt: Which field widget does micon_linkit add, for which field type, and where do I enable it?
evals.expected_output: It adds the micon_linkit widget ('Linkit (with icon)') for the core `link` field type; select it on the field's Manage form display.

evals.prompt: What does the micon_linkit widget combine, and what modules must be enabled for it?
evals.expected_output: It combines Linkit autocomplete (extends LinkitWidget) with Micon's icon controls (MiconLinkWidgetTrait); requires the contrib linkit module and micon_link.

evals.prompt: Where does the micon_linkit widget store the icon an editor chooses for a link?
evals.expected_output: On the link value at options.attributes.data-icon (same as micon_link).

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a Link field field_micon_lkt_med. Inspect the live default form display and report which widget it uses.
evals.expected_output: It uses the micon_linkit widget, per core.entity_form_display.node.article.default component field_micon_lkt_med (type: micon_linkit).

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a Link field field_micon_lkt_task using the plain core link widget. Using micon_linkit, switch that field's form-display widget to the Micon Linkit widget (micon_linkit) and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_micon_lkt_task component has widget type micon_linkit.
